degree_match.note: GIRG has no mean-degree knob; w_min was bisected at n=300 (tau=2.5, alpha_g=1.2) until the realised mean degree landed within 0.05 of the configuration model's realised 4.0285 - inside the 0.14 replicate standard error, i.e. an approximate match adequate for a demo, not a production-grade calibration. Reproduce with: arch -arm64 python3 scripts/dump_poster_demo_traces.py --calibrate

demo.headline: Does geometry change the story?
demo.caption: Bottom: the same heavy-tailed hubs, but every bank now sits somewhere on a map and links prefer near neighbours. Same fear (0.4), same average number of links (4.2 vs 4.1 here), same two-bank shock. Geometry changes what the burn looks like, not whether it burns - 85% of the network without geometry, 82% with.
